name: Mahabodhi Temple Visit
description: Visit the UNESCO World Heritage site where Lord Buddha attained enlightenment under the Bodhi Tree.

name: Nalanda University Ruins Tour
description: Explore the expansive red-brick ruins of one of the world's oldest residential universities.

name: Bihar Museum Exploration
description: A modern, world-class museum showcasing the rich history and artifacts of ancient Bihar.

name: Vishwa Shanti Stupa Ropeway
description: Take a scenic ropeway ride up the Ratnagiri hill to visit the beautiful white Peace Pagoda.

name: Golghar Climb & Park
description: Climb the spiral staircase of this massive 18th-century granary for a panoramic view of the Ganges and Patna city.

name: Ganges River Boat Ride
description: Enjoy a peaceful boat ride on the holy river Ganges, especially beautiful during the evening Aarti.

name: Rajgir Glass Bridge Walk
description: Walk across the thrilling transparent glass bridge suspended over the lush Rajgir gorge.

name: Sher Shah Suri Tomb Visit
description: Visit the magnificent red sandstone mausoleum built in the middle of an artificial lake.

name: Kakolat Waterfall Picnic
description: A scenic waterfall cascading down from a height of 160 feet into a cool natural reservoir.

name: Vaishali Ashokan Pillar
description: See the remarkably preserved lion pillar erected by Emperor Ashoka near the ancient coronation tank.

name: Takht Sri Patna Sahib
description: Visit the holy Gurdwara built in remembrance of the birthplace of Guru Gobind Singh Ji.

name: Meditation at Bodhi Tree
description: Sit and meditate quietly under the sacred descendant of the original Bodhi tree.

name: Griddhakuta Peak Trek
description: Trek up the 'Vulture's Peak' where Lord Buddha preached many of his famous sermons.

name: Sujata Stupa & Village Walk
description: Walk through rural Bodh Gaya to the ancient stupa dedicated to the milkmaid who fed Buddha.

name: Authentic Bihari Thali Experience
description: Relish a traditional Bihari thali including Litti Chokha, Sattu Paratha, and local sweets.
